item.title: Wisp 1.3.2
item.description:
• Fixed: on some Macs every capture failed with a text-recognition error. Wisp now retries, and if reading the text still fails it sends the picture to the AI instead of giving up.
  • Faster first capture: Wisp gets its text reader ready when it opens.
  • New: grab the faint Invisible Ink words and drag them anywhere. Wisp remembers the spot, and clicks beside the words still go to the app underneath.
